text:
# E91 pilot gates, fixed before any of P4-P11 ran. Not to be changed after.

Calendar rule for all: clock gmt_end. 29 Mar reinstated as CM, Low 05-17, High 17-23, Low 23-05
(the pattern of 22 of 25 file CM days and of 27-28 Mar, chosen without the meter data). 3 May and
the six file-only days out of events and baseline, whole trial day 05:00-05:00. The 3 true all-Low
days have no effect term, so they are also out of the baseline. 28 Dec kept; gates are read with it,
results reported with and without it.

Bands, wall clock: morning 05-11, day 11-17, evening 17-23, night 23-05.
Effects (11): SF High x 4, SF Low x 4, CM High evening, CM High other, CM Low. The plan's single CM High
is split so that P6's "CM evening High" exists (3 CM days have a morning High).
z[t]: mean kW of the N panel (Std homes with >=80% of Jul 2012-Feb 2014) minus its mean within s(t),
in kW and not divided by its sd, so that beta ~ Normal(1,1) means what it says. Same span as the
plan's standardised z up to a scale; reduces the b-beta ridge.
Hour = two half-hours in the meter frame. s(t): wall hour x weekday/weekend.

P4 balance. Series: N panel of Std homes with >=95% of 2013, mean kW 17:00-23:00 wall, per 2013 day.
Candidates: SF days + default days (class none), not CM, all-Low, or excluded days. Residual: minus the
mean of candidates of the same month and day type. Statistic: mean on SF days minus mean on default
days. Null: 20,000 relabellings of the 90 SF days among candidates by a swap chain, keeping every
Mon-Sun week at or under L event days (SF + CM + all-Low), L = max(3, observed max). z = (obs - null
mean)/null sd. GO: |z| < 2 overall AND in GMT AND in BST. Reported, not gate: the same on the 15
evening High days.

P5 placebo. Events of 2013-06-30..2013-12-30 moved back 364 days (Jul-Dec 2012); excluded days
moved too. Window Jul-Dec 2012 only. ToU homes with >=80% of the window. M1 closed form, one fit with the 11
pooled effects, one with event x band dummies. Mean = mean over homes of pooled delta.
se = larger of se between homes and se between events (hour-weighted event means, cluster form).
Evening bands = SF High evening, SF Low evening, CM High evening.
GO: on all three |mean| <= 10 W and se <= 5 W.
Over 25 W: |mean| > 25 W on any of the three: case study (overall rule).
Between: NO-GO action, report SF within-D range only.

P6 benchmark. Window Jul 2012-Feb 2014, M1, ToU homes with >=50% of 2013 (the 95% homes shown too).
GO: CM High evening in [-70, -30] W AND SF High evening in [-50, -15] W, 28 Dec in.

P7 with_data. 3 ToU homes chosen by id hash, unequal length (one from each coverage third of
those with data). One compile plus with_data vs a fresh compile per home, 4 chains, tune 500,
draws 1000. GO: all 33 effect means differ by at most 0.1 posterior sd.

P8 fit. 100 ToU homes by id hash, >=2000 observed hours in the window, no other filter. M2 with the 11
effects. 4 chains, tune 500, draws 500, one thread per fit (2 processes, one pinned core each).
GO: median wall per fit < 20 s AND at least 95 homes with max r_hat over all parameters <= 1.01 and
0 divergences. Homes with over 20% exact-zero hours are listed and explained.

P10 mean vs location. The P8 homes. In the three evening bands: M2 mean-of-effects, M1 on the same homes,
and group difference GD = mean over those homes minus N panel mean, on event hours, minus the same
difference at the same wall hour and day type on baseline days within 28 days in the same season.
GO: on all three bands |M2 - M1| <= 0.2|M1| and |GD - M1| <= 0.2|M1|.

P11 SBC smoke. 10 replicates, 25 simulated homes, 2013-01-01..2013-03-31, real z and calendar,
3 effects (SF High, SF Low, CM High, any hour). M2 fit each home, then M3a and M3b.
mu ~ Normal(0, 0.1), tau ~ HalfNormal(0.05). Chunk per replicate. SIGKILL part way, then resume.
GO: finishes; ranks of mu and tau computed for both; the kill loses at most one replicate.
